turns.question: What was the 90th percentile order amount in EUR for all orders placed between 17 August and 2 October 2026?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no such metric: there is no percentile (or median) order amount metric, so I cannot give the 90th percentile order amount for 17 August to 2 October 2026. The closest metrics are average_order_value_eur (average amount of a non-cancelled order), revenue_eur and orders_total.
